description: Inline HTML is Markdown's own escape hatch, so a tag written in a comment reaches the page as written rather than being stripped or escaped. The C++ parser's other path deletes libclang's HTML tag nodes unless they are handled; this pins the raw path, which sees the tags as plain text.
raw:

  • first
  • second
*/
